mechanism: Armodafinil is metabolized by CYP3A4 and may be affected by dexamethasone's CYP3A4 induction; dexamethasone may reduce armodafinil efficacy while armodafinil can potentiate CNS and cardiovascular effects of corticosteroids.
action: Monitor clinical response to armodafinil and consider dose adjustment; assess for signs of corticosteroid excess (insomnia, agitation, tachycardia); use combination cautiously in patients with cardiovascular disease or psychiatric conditions.
